title: IT Project Manager
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

*Enterprise Information Systems (EIS) PMO \| Career Level: Professional Contributor III (P3\)*

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever.


As an IT Project Manager at the P3 level, you will own medium\-to\-complex projects end\-to\-end: shaping the business case, driving planning and execution, and delivering measurable outcomes on time and within budget. You will operate with real independence, determining the best path to the objective while partnering closely with business sponsors, technical teams, vendors, and Micron leadership.


This role is positioned for a project manager who has moved beyond executing defined tasks and is trusted to lead through ambiguity, influence stakeholders without formal authority, mentor less experienced team members, and build the independent judgment needed for driving project outcomes

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Project Initiation**

* Develop project charters that clearly define objectives, scope, benefits, and success criteria.
* Identify stakeholders and build RACI matrices that establish clear decision rights from day one.
* Define high\-level scope, milestones, and timelines aligned to the business case and Micron’s strategic roadmap.
* Identify cross\-domain dependencies early and connect the problem to project and PMO outcomes, not just deliverables.
* Support vendor selection and partner engagement through scoping conversations and early commercial input.

**Project Planning**

* Establish project governance, including sponsors, core team, and extended project team, and drive effective kickoff activities.
* Facilitate business and technical requirements gathering across functional and technical stakeholder groups.
* Establish and maintain project management artifacts, ensuring a well\-governed and transparent tracking of project progress, risks, and dependencies
* Forecast project spend, SOWs, and POs, and support financial planning and budget tracking throughout the lifecycle.
* Support executive reviews and stage\-gate approvals with decision\-ready materials, not just status updates.

**Project Execution \& Closure**

* Manage project scope, quality, schedule, and deliverables, adapting the plan as new information emerges.
* Track development, SOE, and UAT milestones, and translate progress into clear, decision\-ready status for leadership.
* Proactively manage risks, issues, and escalations by bringing recommendations and options, not just problems.
* Provide consistent and accurate status reporting to PMO and leadership teams.
* Facilitate lessons learned and drive formal project closure and approval.

**Leadership and PMO Excellence**

* Lead cross\-functional project teams and build shared alignment around the project vision.
* Resolve conflicts constructively and manage resource allocation across the project team.
* Provide mentorship to less experienced team members and contribute to continuous improvement in PMO process efficiency.
* Actively adopt AI\-enabled tools and workflows to improve planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**
-----------------------------

* 5\+ years of Project Management experience, including ownership of medium\-to\-complex, cross\-functional projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently under project or sub\-function objectives, determining the best method to deliver rather than requiring step\-by\-step direction.
* Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies, applied to fit the project context.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to produce decision\-ready updates for sponsors and leadership.
* Strong change management capabilities and experience facilitating stakeholder alignment without formal authority.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity, reporting, or analytics tools applied to project or portfolio management.
* Experience mentoring junior project team members
* Inclusive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with technical, non\-technical, vendor, and leadership teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* PMP certification.
* Experience managing enterprise\-wide, cross\-functional programs spanning multiple sites or geographies.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, Project Management, or equivalent certifications/professional experience. Related disciplines considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience in enterprise technology, infrastructure, security, digital workplace, platform migration, application delivery or related programs

**How Success Is Measured:**
----------------------------


Success in this role is measured through strong delivery against P3 expectations, including independent decision\-making, governance leadership, stakeholder influence, analytical rigor, AI\-enabled PMO excellence, coaching, integrity, and measurable project outcomes.

**Career Growth:**
------------------


Strong, sustained performance against the P3 competency bar, particularly independent decision\-making, governance leadership, and coaching, is the primary pathway to expanded scope and future progression.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  

  

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  

  

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

title: Senior Project Coordinator - Project Planning

P6 experience is good to have
  
Excellent written and verbal skills with a fluent proficiency in English.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. title: Technical Program Manager, Google Global Networking
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience in program management.
* 2 years of experience designing, constructing, or managing infrastructure projects.
* Experience creating infrastructure designs (e.g., telecom, electrical, mechanical), drawing sets for builds, and remodels of data center networking spaces.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in Network, Electrical, Industrial, Mechanical, or other Engineering related field.
* Experience with data center, networking, or telecom operations.
* Experience with both Outside Plant (OSP) and Inside Plant (ISP) fiber optic infrastructure, including deep knowledge of Dark Fiber, Network Infrastructure, ISP/OSP Network Architecture, Network Topology, and Field Deployment.
* Excellent problem solving and communication skills, with the ability to construct, articulate, and defend simple messages or insights from analysis.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. **The Role**


We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross\-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  

  

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  

  

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co\-located, and there isn't always a well\-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  

  

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  

  

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end\-to\-end technology programs — translate high\-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third\-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non\-co\-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.

* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.
